title: Kruskal-Szekeres Equivalent Coordinates for the FRW Metric
content: In this paper, the flat FRW metric coordinates are transformed into Kruskal-Szekeres equivalent coordinates.  In doing so, it is shown that the FRW metric occupies regions II and IV of the Kruskal-Szekeres coordinate chart beyond the Schwarzschild singularity and that the Big Bang and Schwarzschild singularities are coincident on the chart.  It also reveals that the FRW spacetime has a PT symmetric mirror twin.  Given that this twin moves in the opposite direction of time on the diagram (the future-pointing arrows for each twin point in opposite directions on the diagram), we conjecture that this 'Antiverse' is made of anti-matter, resolving the paradox of the missing anti-matter in our Universe.
